title: Pool protocol v1 message: work_offer (coordinator -> router)
description: Phase 1 of two-phase dispatch (D-D2): the coordinator offers a queued job to a candidate router. The router answers with offer_accept (short lease) or offer_reject (coordinator moves to the next candidate WITHOUT transferring the body). No prompt/response content is carried here.

job_id.description: Unique id of the queued job (assigned by the coordinator at intake).

tag.description: Pool class/tag the job requests, e.g. "pool-text-lg".

est_prompt_tokens.description: Estimated prompt size in tokens (from intake; never derived from body content by the coordinator).

est_ctx_needed.description: Context length the request is expected to need (prompt + expected response); drives member selection (D-D4) and overflow pre-checks.

deadline_ms.description: Service deadline in milliseconds (relative to dispatch), or null if the job has none.

priority.description: live = interactive request; batch = async batch item (always lower priority than live, D-F4).

source.description: How this job reached dispatch: queue = normal queue; skip = skip-the-line continuation (D-E2); pin = soft pin on the last-serving member (D-E3).

conv_key.description: Continuity key if known: SHA-256 (64 hex) of the first 8 KiB of the raw client payload (D-E1). null for new conversations and batch items.
